com.nube.mqtt.publish.label: MQTT Publish
com.nube.mqtt.publish.summary: Publish one message to an MQTT broker.
com.nube.mqtt.publish.help: Sends a single MQTT message to the configured broker. Set the topic + QoS in the node settings; route the payload through the input slot.
com.nube.mqtt.subscribe.label: MQTT Subscribe
com.nube.mqtt.subscribe.summary: Trigger flows on inbound MQTT messages.
com.nube.mqtt.subscribe.help: Opens an MQTT subscription on the configured broker and fires the flow once per inbound message until the run is cancelled.
